traits.value: uncommon, cleric, concentrate, metamagic, necromancy, oracle, wizard

prerequisites.value: ability to permanently create or control undead;  cleric with a negative font, oracle of oracle, or wizard wizard

requirements.value: You have at least one undead minion that you permanently control.

special.value: This feat has the trait matching your spellcasting tradition.

description.value: You repurpose the negative energy that flows through your minions at a moment's notice. Instantly destroy one undead minion within 60 feet that is permanently under your control. If your next action is to cast a necromancy spell from a spell slot, you don't expend the slot. The spell's level must be half the destroyed minion's level or lower and the spell can't have a duration.
